name: Offline Sync
description: Keeps an encrypted copy of the form on the device and saves changed values in the background, so a dropped connection does not lose what has been typed. Includes the @AUTOSAVE action tags from Auto-Save Value by Luke Stevens, Murdoch Children's Research Institute, on which this module is built.

action-tags.description: Tag a text field with @AUTOSAVE to have the value saved automatically after its value is updated.
As @AUTOSAVE, but in data entry mode only, not in survey mode.
As @AUTOSAVE, but in survey mode only, not in data entry mode.
As @AUTOSAVE-FORM, but suppress the field's save icon where in data entry mode it would normally be shown.
As @AUTOSAVE-SURVEY, but show the field's save icon where in survey mode it would normally be suppressed.

project-settings.name:
Offline mode
Separate from the @AUTOSAVE action tags, which need no configuration. Choose which instruments to protect; nothing is protected until a choice is made. On data entry forms changed values are also saved in the background; on survey pages the form is held on the device and offered back after a reload.
Discard on-device drafts older than this many hours (default 12)

Text for "reason for change" (default is "offline_sync")
Used by the action tags and by offline mode. Neither can ask a user for a reason, so the same text is logged every time.
